outcome: Restore readable stored animal populations hidden by a missing or mismatched companion herd index. This is a prerequisite repair, not completion of the full trophy-level/main-map gameplay correction.

previousCheckpoint.note: Preserve the prior managed-installer repair, failed owner-installation report, screenshot intake, Xbox/account recovery, herd/location work and full Phase 1 scope. None is reset by this release.

native.platform: Hosted Linux, complete repository and production catalogs

recoveryBrowser.scope: Actual PC Insights and signed phone with retained synthetic binary population, no source file and no optional spawn area; visible animal/herd counts, original saved time, exact stored payload bytes, stable IDs, SQLite restart/reconnect, spoiler revocation and guest denial.

existingBrowserGates.scope: All existing enforced browser-play, herds, locations, saved-game, pairing, zone, discovery, cache and studio workflows retained. These and recovery use synthetic player data, not owner files.

failurePreserved.reason: The browser restored visible counts but a payload equality assertion used a pre-serialization object with area: undefined. The existing JSON Store omitted that property before recovery. The verifier now compares the actual pre-start persisted payload AND compressed database bytes; all count/ID/pairing/restart assertions remain. Runtime code was unchanged by the verifier correction.

ownerAcceptance.requiredGameplay: Choose a reserve/species, see animal counts across supported trophy levels and separate difficulty levels, select a count, and inspect corresponding herds and zones on the main map.

completedVerified: Missing/source-mismatched herd indexes are rebuilt from retained decoded populations before scans; no new game save is required for that recovery. Original saved timestamps and payload bytes stay intact.

Absent optional spawn origins do not reject otherwise readable animals; a missing origin is not used to infer structural identity continuity. Existing unsupported history schemas are not overwritten. Failed transactions preserve sequence and source and retry.

Released the exact repair through the existing managed feed and matching package, and merged source into the working branch without content differences. No new host, environment, plan, key, provider or account changes.
stillOpen: The cause on the owner's uninspected Windows device remains unproved. A screenshot showing career totals does not prove a readable current reserve population or a specific installed revision.

The complete Bronze/Silver/Gold/no-trophy and difficulty/main-map candidate is NOT part of this release. The combined pending map candidate passed 124 focused synthetic-data checks but has not passed full production-catalog/rendered PC/phone acceptance. The published hotfix's 62 local checks and 926 hosted suite are not proof of the pending map candidate.
All prior Xbox-first, actual harvest intake, account recovery, physical device, installer acceptance and Phase 1 requirements remain open. SI remediation follows accepted Phase 1.
